verdict.rationale: There is evidence of a dedicated sandbox API endpoint (api.sandbox.namecheap.com) separate from production, which is the core mechanism for testing without touching live data, but the pack shows only bare endpoint references and error responses rather than documentation of sandbox setup, test data isolation, or confirmation it fully mirrors production behavior. missing for 10: sandbox onboarding/documentation detail, confirmation of full feature parity with production, independent developer corroboration of sandbox reliability.
